pages.title: From sign-up to your first text
pages.subtitle: Five stages, about 20 days, and one gate that sets how fast you go live.

blocks.note: Typical timeline; carrier approval sets the pace.

blocks.title: No texting until carriers approve you
blocks.text: You can't send texts or calls until your business is registered and carrier-approved (10DLC or Toll-Free). We prepare and submit it; carriers decide, usually within several business days, occasionally longer.

rows.label: 1. Welcome & kickoff
rows.note: You have your onboarding plan and timeline in writing.

rows.label: 2. Compliance & registration
rows.note: Your Brand and Campaign are carrier-approved and sending is unlocked.

rows.label: 3. Account setup
rows.note: Numbers, users and integrations are live and a test message sends.

rows.label: 4. Training
rows.note: Admins and users are trained and have the recording and recap.

rows.label: 5. Go-live & support
rows.note: You're live, measured and on a regular check-in cadence.

paragraphs.text: Getting us your business details early and accurate is the single biggest way to go live faster. Account setup runs in parallel.

pages.title: Who does what at each stage
pages.subtitle: Here's what Salesmessage handles and what we need from you to keep moving.

rows.definition: Match you with an Onboarding Manager (and a CSM, by plan) and run your kickoff call.
Prepare, submit and manage your carrier registration; fix and resubmit anything that comes back.
Set up numbers, inboxes, users, assignment rules, business hours and permissions; connect your CRM.
Run a 1:1 admin session and a group session for your users.
Check in on go-live morning, then follow up about two weeks later on blockers and KPIs.
Bring your contacts, use case, user and number counts, tools to connect and live date.
Send us the Stage 2 checklist, and have your opt-in form reviewed before you submit.
Confirm your users, numbers and integrations, such as HubSpot, Aircall or RingCentral.
Book the sessions and get your team on them.
Start texting, and bring anything you need to your Customer Success Manager.

blocks.title: Which registration you need
blocks.text: 10DLC covers local numbers. Toll-Free Verification covers toll-free numbers and all Canadian numbers. Numbers can be new, transferred, ported or hosted.

pages.title: Clear the compliance gate fast
pages.subtitle: Bring these to Stage 2 and you'll clear the gate fast.

rows.definition: Your legal business name and EIN / Tax ID, exactly as on your IRS documents.
An active site with a Privacy Policy (including SMS consent language) and Terms.
A link or screenshot of how people agree to texts: web form, paper, keyword or QR.
What you'll send, plus a couple of real example messages with your brand name.
Who needs access, and whether you're bringing existing numbers.
The CRM and tools you want connected.

blocks.title: A rejection isn't a dead end
blocks.text: If the carriers send something back, we tell you exactly what to change and resubmit it for you.

items.question: Why do registrations get rejected?
items.answer: A legal name that doesn't match IRS records, a new EIN still propagating (30–90 days), or one opt-in checkbox covering all message types.

items.question: Should I get my opt-in form checked?
items.answer: Yes. If your opt-in form isn't built yet, ask us to review it before you submit — that's the #1 cause of rejections.

items.question: Not sure which stage you're in?
items.answer: Ask your Onboarding Manager or CSM. They can tell you your stage and what's outstanding.

items.question: What does training cover?
items.answer: 1:1 texting, broadcasts, tags, contacts, calling, your CRM integration and SMS best practices. Weekly live webinars and the Help Center stay open after.
